command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; set -uo pipefail does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p out
sha256sum -c stage.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: stage.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
python3 -u stage.py > out/stage.log 2>&1
RC=$?
cat out/stage.log
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: staging failed"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'STAGE OK' out/stage.log || { echo "FAIL: no completion sentinel"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
